content: Financial services, bearing the highest attack burden at 35.0%, alongside heavily targeted and resource-constrained government entities, highlight the pressing need for updated, geographically tailored, and technologically advanced defense mechanisms. To combat the growing sophistication of cybercriminal operations, South African organizations have increasingly turned to advanced technological solutions. A pertinent historical example of this technological efficacy occurred in 2022, when South African financial services companies successfully repelled a highly sophisticated ransomware attack by leveraging advanced AI-driven defensive mechanisms [Source 5].
